caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a creamer jug, rendered in shades of gray with pencil on a beige or off-white background. The jug has a curvy, bulbous body, an ornate handle on the left side, and an elongated spout on the right. The top rim is scalloped and irregular in shape. The jug stands on three short, decorative legs shaped like lion paws or shells. The drawing is bordered by a double rectangular outline, and there are two areas with orange-brown stains—one in the upper right corner and one in the lower left. A horizontal line is visible behind the jug, suggesting a surface or table. The lower right corner of the drawing includes legible handwritten text that reads “CREAMER Size: About 4" tall No. 18799-35 Joseph Schott,” and in the lower left, “CASE No. 2” is written.
title: Silver Creamer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
